chunks: Ja'far ibn Bashir, from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
I said: A man killed a man from the People of the Covenant. He said: “He is not killed for him unless he is one who is habitually given to killing.”

key_terms.أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ: non-Muslim protected subjects living under covenant and protection
key_terms.لَا يُقْتَلُ بِهِ: qisas by execution is not carried out for killing him
key_terms.لِلْقَتْلِ: to killing; the act of homicide
key_terms.مُتَعَوِّدًا: habitually accustomed; repeatedly doing the act

ai.seo_question: Is a Muslim executed in qisas for killing a man from Ahl al-Dhimmah according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a Muslim who kills a man from Ahl al-Dhimmah. It states that qisas by execution is not applied in this case unless the killer is known to be repeatedly accustomed to killing.
